dialogue.speaker: scp682
dialogue.text: I am SCP Six Eight Two, the reptile that cannot die.

dialogue.speaker: pegasus
dialogue.text: I am Pegasus, winged steed of Olympus.

dialogue.speaker: pegasus
dialogue.text: I outfly every storm and bear Zeus's thunder.

sentences.speaker: scp682
sentences.text: I am SCP Six Eight Two, the reptile that cannot die.

sentences.speaker: scp682
sentences.text: Every strike feeds my evolution.

sentences.speaker: scp682
sentences.text: You are...

sentences.speaker: scp682
sentences.text: disgusting.

sentences.speaker: pegasus
sentences.text: I am Pegasus, winged steed of Olympus.

sentences.speaker: pegasus
sentences.text: I outfly every storm and bear Zeus's thunder.

sentences.speaker: pegasus
sentences.text: Your rampage ends here.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Containment failed, and SCP Six Eight Two tore out of the lab straight into the city.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It tore through downtown streets in chaos, until Pegasus dived from the storm clouds.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Radiant wings slammed the monster back, locking the city into a war zone.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: High above the towers, Pegasus dominated the sky; the grounded beast could not reach.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Diving like a meteor, Pegasus drove a divine hoof-kick straight through its ribs.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then Pegasus summoned Zeus's lightning, scorching the reptile to smoking ash.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Yet nothing kills it; torn flesh knitted back in seconds.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Worse, its body adapted, locking into dark armor immune to lightning.

sentences.speaker: scp682
sentences.text: Your thunder means nothing!

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Bone glands erupted, firing jagged spikes and corrosive acid straight into the skyline.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then its back ripped open, unfurling colossal horror wings to hunt the sky.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Now matched in the air, the evolving monster began overwhelming the winged steed.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Pegasus could never erase its regeneration, and exhaustion closed in.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Choosing its only chance, Pegasus burst free and rocketed straight toward Olympus.

sentences.speaker: pegasus
sentences.text: Only Zeus can end you!

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Above the shattered skyline, golden storm clouds began gathering on Mount Olympus.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Alone in the ruins, the winged reptile glared straight at the throne of the gods.

sentences.speaker: scp682_whisper
sentences.text: Bring your god.
